inventory.producer: parallel.ts runPool admission and result retention; runPlannedCard -> outcomeOfExit; parallel-entry.ts createBatch/runBatch and loopDeps wire actual handler selection to runners, terminal output, recordBatch and exit; watch-loop.ts runWatchLoop aggregates loop exit. parallel.test.ts owns guard-strength finding r0-2.
inputs: Ordered eligible root 9 and descendant 10; root process exits 0 with skipReason=prepare-needs-human
Descendant exits 0 without skip, exits 0 with skip, exits 2, or terminates with SIGKILL
Pool limit 1 with no shared resource; limit 2 with shared-scope mutex
Both handleRunCommand single-batch and watch=true with maxIterations=1; limit 2 with no shared resources and deterministically overlapping runners
representations: CardProcessExit supplied at external engine/process boundary
handleRunCommand parsed CLI arguments and real root plan
Actual reportOutcomes console output and recordBatch appendAudit boundary
Actual single-batch and watch-loop returned status
consumers: Direct runPool/runPlannedCard -> terminal events -> renderBatchAuditLine -> batchExitCode
handleRunCommand -> parallel-entry.ts runBatch -> createBatch -> reportOutcomes, recordBatch, batchExitCode
handleRunCommand -> parallel-entry.ts runLoop/loopDeps -> createBatch -> reportOutcomes, recordBatch -> runWatchLoop/finishLoop exit
classes: limit > 1 with no shared resource: both runners overlap; neither descendant result nor its aggregate effect may disappear
CLI single-batch and watch-loop consumers each cross completed/skipped/failed/crashed descendant with sequential/shared-mutex/unconstrained scheduling
interactions: Four descendant terminals x three admission classes x three consumers (direct pool, single-batch handler, watch-loop handler); 36 executable cases
Each scheduled runner -> real outcome mapping -> emitted card-end -> printed batch outcome -> recorded batch audit -> returned exit
Deterministic parallel overlap: root waits for descendant start; descendant waits for root terminal event; both calls precede root completion
inventory.scopeBoundary: r0-2 guard strength only. Selection and prerequisite authority stubbed at external boundary; candidates already eligible. Four descendant terminal classes are the requested clean/failed/crashed process results; interruption and external lock refusal are different unchanged obligations. Watch capped at one real batch avoids unrelated retry/selection policy. No workflow persistence, evidence identity or ledger transition is created or changed; S12 not applicable.
